description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 assets). New apps: Table Notes (vivekagarwal.playwithdb 20261111) premium unlock for PDF/Word/Excel export, publishing and the paid set, with the AdMob banner/interstitial slots skipped; Netflix (Android TV, com.netflix.ninja) clone, CertCheck, household-prompt, network-fingerprint and in-process ad-remover patch set ported from ajstrick81/morphe-androidtv-patches (GPL-3.0). Fixes: the Mereframe wrapper sweep now preserves each guarded wrapper's array-length contract (p/a/V/m expect 3 elements, T expects 12) and keeps the catch handler outside its own try range, so the develop/encode path stops silently producing nothing ("RAW is safe" but it didn't develop, issue #34); Reddit comment TreeData is discovered by constructor shape so Show deleted posts and comments applies on both 2026.42.0 builds (issue #35); Amazon Business + screenshot detection from PR #31 are in the bundle. Verified by building the Android bundle, applying the Table Notes and Mereframe patches to the real APKs and dumping the patched DEX; on-device runtime verification of the new app patches is still pending.
